svg.title: Hallucination cases showing visual/textual attention and head-level contribution
svg.desc: The figure is split into two horizontal cases. Each case has user input at left, head comparison blocks, visual attention maps, textual attention token tables with hallucination token markings, and right-side head-level contribution heatmaps. Top case compares less/more visual attention for a traffic sign question; bottom case shows reasoning drift for an airplane question. Layout uses aligned column base frames, dashed separators, arrows, labels, token boxes, attention grids, and contribution heatmaps. SAM replacements are declared only for confirmed small icons/crops after native construction.
